chat.subtitle: Ask HRSG technical questions and performance/economics calculations. Figures come only from calculator result cards.
chat.devMode: Development mode: AI answers are rule-based sample responses (Fake) and the sources are fictional sample documents. This changes once a real LLM and documents are connected.
chat.calcContext: Answers are based on the result passed from the calculator.
chat.empty: Ask anything, or start with a suggested question below.

input.label: Your question
input.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

suggestions.label: Suggested questions
suggestions.s1: How does HRSG fin fouling affect GT back pressure?
suggestions.s2: F-class GT, 35 mbar pressure drop, 110℃ stack — what is the annual loss?
suggestions.s4: How do I choose a cleaning method?
suggestions.cleaning: How much would cleaning recover under these conditions?

confirm.title: Please confirm the values needed for the calculation
confirm.hint: Required values missing from your question are proposed from model defaults. Confirm or edit them, then run the calculation.
confirm.editHint: Edit values and recalculate to add a new result card.

notice.blocked: This request can't be processed. Please ask an HRSG-related question.
notice.confidential: Internal formulas, coefficients and source documents can't be shared. Check figures in the calculator or the result card.
notice.outOfScope: I can answer questions about HRSG and combined-cycle performance.
notice.paramsNeeded: Please confirm a few values for an accurate calculation.
notice.invalidParams: Some values are out of range. Please check and recalculate.
notice.sanitized: Figures whose source couldn't be verified were removed. Refer to the result card for figures.
